items.definition:
the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation
Car manufacturers are working to reduce harmful emissions.

the quality of being outstanding or extremely good
The company strives for excellence in all its products.

a person or animal that lives in or occupies a place
The island's inhabitants rely on fishing for their livelihood.

intelligence information, especially of a military or political nature
We received some valuable intel about the competitor's plans.

the quantity of motion of a moving body; the impetus gained by a moving object
The team gained momentum in the second half of the game.

nomination
Her nomination for the award was well-deserved.

obligation
He felt an obligation to help his family.

outlook
The economic outlook for next year is positive.

PhD (Doctor of Philosophy)
She is currently working on her PhD.

reed
The ducks hid among the tall reeds by the river.

submission
The deadline for essay submission is Friday.

a system of voting
The citizens cast their ballots in the election.

a shortfall or lack
The country is facing a large budget deficit.

an evil spirit or devil
According to the legend, a demon guarded the treasure.

the action or process of detecting something
Early detection of the disease can save lives.

expert skill or knowledge
He has great expertise in computer programming.

the main body or frame of a ship or boat
The ship's hull was damaged in the storm.

a sign or piece of information that indicates something
There was no indication of a problem.

a long, thin mark or stripe; a continuous period of success or failure
He's on a winning streak.

the ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behavior that one dislikes or disagrees with
We need to show more tolerance towards different cultures.

a short period of intense activity of a specified kind
He suffered a severe bout of flu.

a return to a former position of success or popularity
The band made a great comeback.

a measurable extent of some kind, such as length, breadth, or depth
We need to consider every dimension of the problem.

the degree to which something is successful in producing a desired result
The effectiveness of the new policy is still being evaluated.

an act of gaining unauthorized access to data in a system or computer
The company reported a major data hack.

intense dislike or ill will
The conflict was fueled by deep-seated hatred.

a restricting condition or circumstance
Every system has its limitations.

the ability to move or be moved freely and easily
Improved public transport increases urban mobility.

the relative physical position or direction of something
New employees attend an orientation session.

a person who shoots a gun; a person who takes photographs or videos
The police are searching for the shooter.

position or attitude
The company's stance on environmental issues is clear.

a long essay or dissertation
She is writing her master's thesis.

the activity of fighting a war
Modern warfare involves advanced technology.

the act of taking money out of an account
I made a cash withdrawal from the ATM.

an official inspection of accounts
The company is undergoing an annual financial audit.

a sculpture of a person's head and shoulders
The museum displayed a marble bust of the emperor.

the last part of a piece of music, a show, or a public event
The fireworks were the grand finale of the festival.

lack of knowledge or information
His ignorance of the law was no excuse.

a set of people or things assembled for a particular purpose
The band announced their new lineup for the tour.

a long pipe, typically underground, for conveying oil, gas, etc.
The new oil pipeline will run across the country.

the action of putting something in a particular place or position
She found a good job placement after graduation.

a desire to hurt, annoy, or offend someone
He broke the toy out of spite.

a person who analyzes
She works as a financial analyst for a large bank.

a small church or place of worship
They held the wedding ceremony in a small chapel.

an organ that filters blood
The human body has two kidneys.

large crowd
The angry mob gathered outside the building.

the act of finding the way
Modern cars have excellent navigation systems.

path around a celestial body
The moon is in orbit around the Earth.

land surrounded by water on three sides
Florida is a large peninsula.

what is left
He ate half the cake and gave me the remainder.

something added to complete or enhance
He takes a vitamin supplement every day.

state of being unsure
There was a lot of uncertainty about the future.

set of rules for solving a problem
The search engine uses a complex algorithm.

an imaginary line around which a body rotates
The Earth rotates on its axis.

a large, heavy gun
An old cannon stood guard at the castle entrance.

the state of being complicated
The complexity of the problem made it difficult to solve.

a meeting for discussion or advice
She had a consultation with her doctor about her symptoms.

intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval
She showed great enthusiasm for the new project.

a statement that two expressions are equal
Solve the equation for x.

a short passage taken from a text
The book contains an extract from his diary.

the quality of bending easily without breaking
Yoga helps improve your flexibility.

an instrument for measuring
The fuel gauge showed that the tank was almost empty.

intestine; instinct (informal)
I had a gut feeling that something was wrong.

a division of a baseball game
The home team scored three runs in the ninth inning.
